tree.heading: In general
tree.text: Subject to subsection (c), the amount of a requirements payment made to a State for a year shall be equal to the product of—

children.text: the total amount appropriated for requirements payments for the year pursuant to the authorization under section 21007 of this title; and
the State allocation percentage for the State (as determined under subsection (b)).

tree.heading: State allocation percentage defined
tree.text: The “State allocation percentage” for a State is the amount (expressed as a percentage) equal to the quotient of—

children.text: the voting age population of the State (as reported in the most recent decennial census); and
the total voting age population of all States (as reported in the most recent decennial census).

tree.heading: Minimum amount of payment
tree.text: The amount of a requirements payment made to a State for a year may not be less than—

children.text: in the case of any of the several States or the District of Columbia, one-half of 1 percent of the total amount appropriated for requirements payments for the year under section 21007 of this title; or
in the case of the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico, Guam, American Samoa, or the United States Virgin Islands, one-tenth of 1 percent of such total amount.

tree.heading: Pro rata reductions
tree.text: The Administrator 1 shall make such pro rata reductions to the allocations determined under subsection (a) as are necessary to comply with the requirements of subsection (c).

tree.heading: Continuing availability of funds after appropriation
tree.text: A requirements payment made to a State under this subpart shall be available to the State without fiscal year limitation.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was formerly classified to section 15402 of Title 42, The Public Health and Welfare, prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.
